Hi,

it's not a static method, but it doesn't matter, the problem is about the types.

calling of renjin:

            engine.put("api", api);
            Object eval = engine.eval(reader, context);

api is an object created right before it's passed to renjin, it's an interface for renjin code to e.g. access inMemory cache, persistence layer, (tens of methods providing some functionality) ...

part of R code:

                        from <- 1391212800000
                        to <- 1391299199999
                        identifiers <- c(1,5)
                        result <- api$historicalData()$selectMarketData(from, to, identifiers);
                        resut

[ERROR]

messages.subject: Re: How to call java method with primitive array parameter from renjin
parts:
Hi Thomas,
Renjin should be converting the arguments you're passing - i suspect it is just a bug affecting either the short or long types, i'm not sure there's full test coverage for those types:

https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/core/src/test/java/org/renjin/primitives/JvmiTest.java

If you can contribute a test case I can correct the relevant converters.

Best,
Alex
